reading.title: Bad Brian（壞男孩 Brian）
reading.intro: 學校正在上演戲劇《Bad Brian》。孩子們正在讀劇本。閱讀 Scene 1 和 Scene 2，學習 will / should / shouldn’t 的用法：

paragraphs.text: Scene 1. Setting: Monday morning, at Brian’s home. Characters: Brian, Mum, Dad. Narrator: It’s Monday morning. Brian is surfing the Internet in his bedroom. Mum: Brian, have you finished your homework? Brian: Yes, Mum. Of course, I have. Mum: It’s time to go to school. You shouldn’t be late. Try to be on time for once.
paragraphs.translation: 第一幕。場景：星期一早上，在 Brian 的家。角色：Brian、媽媽、爸爸。旁白：星期一早上。Brian 正在臥室上網。媽媽：Brian，你做完功課了嗎？Brian：是的，媽媽。我當然做完了。媽媽：該上學了。你不應該遲到。這次試試準時吧。
sentences: Scene 1. Setting: Monday morning, at Brian’s home.
Characters: Brian, Mum, Dad.
Narrator: It’s Monday morning. Brian is surfing the Internet in his bedroom.
Mum: Brian, have you finished your homework?
Brian: Yes, Mum. Of course, I have.
Mum: It’s time to go to school. You shouldn’t be late.
Try to be on time for once.

Brian：是的，媽媽。我當然做完了。
媽媽：該上學了。你不應該遲到。
這次試試準時吧。

paragraphs.text: Brian: [impatiently] All right, Mum. Dad: [holding Brian’s workbook] You still haven’t finished your homework, Brian. Mum: [angrily] What? You still have homework to do! You lied to me, Brian. You really should work hard and stop wasting your time surfing the Internet.
paragraphs.translation: Brian：（不耐煩地）好吧，媽媽。爸爸：（拿著 Brian 的練習冊）你還是沒做完功課，Brian。媽媽：（生氣地）什麼？你還有功課要做！你騙了我，Brian。你真的應該努力學習，不要再浪費時間上網了。

paragraphs.text: Narrator: Brian shows Joe the way to his bedroom. Joe: Oh, my goodness. Your room is so messy. You should tidy it up. Well, Brian, I’m not happy that my number one fan is a messy boy. Brian: [embarrassed] Umm ... I’m sorry.
paragraphs.translation: 旁白：Brian 帶 Joe 去他的臥室。Joe：噢，天哪。你的房間太亂了。你應該收拾一下。Brian，我的頭號粉絲居然是個邋遢的男孩，我很不高興。Brian：（尷尬地）嗯……對不起。

paragraphs.text: Joe: Let me tell you something. I came here today because your mother wrote me an e-mail. She’s really worried about you. Brian: [surprised] Oh dear! Mum wrote to you?
paragraphs.translation: Joe：讓我告訴你一些事。我今天來這裡是因為你媽媽給我寫了一封電郵。她真的很擔心你。Brian：（驚訝地）哎呀！媽媽寫信給你了？

paragraphs.text: Joe: Yes. And I have a few important things to tell you. First of all, you should be polite. Secondly, you should be honest. You shouldn’t lie about doing your homework. Thirdly, you should always listen to your parents and teachers.
paragraphs.translation: Joe：是的。我有幾件重要的事情要告訴你。首先，你應該有禮貌。其次，你應該誠實。你不應該謊稱自己做了功課。第三，你應該常常聽父母和老師的話。

grammar.title: will（一般將來式：表達將來的行動）

examples.en: I will tidy up my bedroom. Then, I will do my homework.
examples.zh: 我會整理我的臥室。然後，我會做功課。

examples.en: Brian will receive the Best Student Award next month.

You shouldn’t lie about doing your homework.

practice.intro: 根據 Unit 6（Growing up）內容完成以下練習題：

readingComp.title: 練習 1：閱讀理解選擇題
readingComp.description: 根據課文內容，選擇最佳答案：

questions.text: 1. How many characters are in Scene 1?
questions.explanation: Scene 1 的角色是 Brian、Mum、Dad 共 3 個（旁白 Narrator 不算角色），所以選 c。

questions.text: 2. Which sentence is NOT true about Scene 1?

options.text: a. Brian is surfing the Internet.
c. Brian’s mother is mad at Brian.

questions.explanation: Dad 說 You still haven’t finished your homework，Brian 其實有未完成的功課，所以 d 是錯的，選 d。
questions.zh: 關於第一幕，哪一句是錯誤的？

questions.text: 3. Read Scene 2 again. In line 8, Brian is ‘embarrassed’. What does that mean?

options.text: a. Brian feels bad about what he did.
b. Brian is angry about what Joe said.
c. Brian is happy about Joe’s visit.
d. Brian is proud to be Joe’s number one fan.

questions.explanation: embarrassed 意思是尷尬的、羞愧的。Brian 的房間太亂被偶像發現，覺得難為情，所以選 a。
questions.zh: 再讀第二幕。第 8 行 Brian 感到 ‘embarrassed’。那是什麼意思？

questions.text: 4. Which three words best describe Brian?
questions.explanation: Brian 最後說 I want to be good、道歉、承認自己的房間亂，且對 Joe 有禮貌，所以用 honest（誠實）、polite（有禮貌）、messy（凌亂）描述最合適，選 d。
questions.zh: 哪三個詞最能形容 Brian？

readingQA.title: 練習 2：閱讀理解問答題
readingQA.description: 根據課文內容，用完整的句子回答下列問題：

questions.text: 1. Joe wants to be Brian’s friend. What does he say in Scene 2?
questions.answer: He says, “Hey, my friends call me Joe.”
variations: Hey, my friends call me Joe.
questions.explanation: Joe 在結尾微笑說 Hey, my friends call me Joe，表示把 Brian 當朋友，選這句。
questions.zh: Joe 想和 Brian 做朋友。他在第二幕說了什麼？

questions.text: 2. Are you a good child? What do you think you can do better?
questions.answer: Yes, I am a good child. I can listen to my parents more.
variations: I think I can tidy up my bedroom more often.
questions.explanation: 開放題，自由作答。用 should / shouldn’t 說出你想改進的地方即可。
questions.zh: 你是個好孩子嗎？你覺得自己可以在哪些方面做得更好？

wordBank.title: 練習 3：詞庫填空（好習慣）
wordBank.description: 從詞庫中選擇正確的詞語，完成 Brian 應該做什麼：

items.after: and say sorry to his mum.
items.explanation: Brian 應該對媽媽有禮貌（be polite）。
Brian 應該誠實（be honest），不要說謊。

items.after: and not be late for school.
items.explanation: Brian 應該準時（be on time）上學。
Brian 應該努力學習（work hard）。
Brian 的房間很亂，所以他應該打掃房間（clean his room）。
Brian 應該衣著整潔（dress neatly）。
父母關心 Brian，所以他應該聽父母的話（listen to his parents）。
Brian 應該對同學友善（be friendly）。

sentencePattern.title: 練習 4：劇本填空（will）
sentencePattern.description: 根據 Brian 的新年計劃（Go to the library every weekend / Wash my football uniform / Tidy up my bedroom / Listen to my parents），完成 Scene 3 的劇本：

items.before: 1. First, I want to read more books, so I will
items.answer: go to the library every weekend
items.explanation: Brian 的計劃之一是 Go to the library every weekend，所以填 go to the library every weekend。

items.before: 2. I also want to be a neat and clean boy. I will
items.explanation: 計劃中有 Wash my football uniform，用完後清洗，所以填 wash my football uniform。

items.after: I don’t want it to be messy any more.
items.answer: I will tidy up my bedroom
items.explanation: 計劃中有 Tidy up my bedroom，表示不想房間再亂，所以填 I will tidy up my bedroom。

items.after: because they care a lot about me.
items.answer: I will listen to my parents
items.explanation: 計劃中有 Listen to my parents，因為父母很關心他，所以填 I will listen to my parents。

discussion.title: 練習 5：討論與口語
discussion.description: 和同學討論，然後回答問題：

questions.text: 1. What should Brian do and not do to win the Best Student Award?
questions.reference:
參考答案： He should work hard and be honest. He shouldn’t be late or lie.
中文翻譯： 他應該努力和誠實。他不應該遲到或說謊。

questions.text: 2. What will you do to become a good boy or girl?
questions.reference:
參考答案： I will tidy up my bedroom. I will listen to my parents.
中文翻譯： 我會整理我的臥室。我會聽父母的話。

questions.text: 3. What should you and shouldn’t you do in a play audition?
questions.reference:
參考答案： We should be polite and speak clearly. We shouldn’t be late or be naughty.
中文翻譯： 我們應該有禮貌、說話清晰。我們不應該遲到或頑皮。

sections.title: 文法辨識題（每題 1 分）

options.text: a. I will tidy up my bedroom tomorrow.
b. I tidy will up my bedroom tomorrow.
c. I will up tidy my bedroom tomorrow.
d. Will I tidy up my bedroom tomorrow.

questions.explanation: will 後面接動詞原形，正確句是 I will tidy up my bedroom tomorrow.，所以選 a。

questions.text: 2. Which sentence means ‘You must not be late’?
questions.explanation: shouldn’t 表示「不應該」，You shouldn’t be late 即「你不應該遲到」，選 b。

sections.title: 詞彙理解題（每題 1 分）

questions.explanation: messy 意思是凌亂的、不整潔的（untidy），所以選 b。

questions.text: 2. Who reads the story in a play?
questions.explanation: 在戲劇中講述故事的是旁白（narrator），所以選 a。

sections.title: 閱讀理解選擇題（每題 2 分）

questions.text: 1. Why was Mum angry with Brian?

options.text: a. He was late for school.
b. He lied about his homework.

questions.explanation: Mum 說 You lied to me, Brian，Brian 謊稱做完功課，所以媽媽生氣，選 b。

questions.text: 2. What did Joe tell Brian to do first?
questions.explanation: Joe 說 First of all, you should be polite，首先要有禮貌，選 a。

sections.title: will / should 填空題（每題 2 分）
sections.description: 用 will / should / shouldn’t 填空：

questions.text: 1. You ____ work hard to get good marks.
questions.explanation: 給建議用 should：You should work hard（你應該努力）。

questions.text: 2. I ____ tidy up my bedroom tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 表示將來要做的事用 will：I will tidy up my bedroom。

sections.title: 句型運用題（每題 3 分）
sections.prompt: 用 should 或 shouldn’t 寫一句給同學的建議：
sections.answer: You should listen to your parents.
sections.explanation: 示例：You should listen to your parents.（你應該聽父母的話。）或 You shouldn’t be late.（你不應該遲到。）用 should/shouldn’t + 動詞原形即可。

learningPoints.title: Unit 6：Growing up（成長）
goals: 能閱讀戲劇（Play）劇本並理解內容
能認識好習慣詞彙（tidy up, be polite, be honest 等）
能用 will 表達將來的行動
能用 should / shouldn’t 談論規則
能用 First of all / Secondly / Thirdly 列舉

sections.title: 1. 好習慣詞彙：
items: be friendly, be honest, be on time, be polite
clean his room, dress neatly, listen to his parents, work hard

sections.title: 2. 一般將來式 will：
items: I will tidy up my bedroom.
Brian will receive the Best Student Award next month.

sections.title: 3. 規則 should / shouldn’t：
items: You should work hard. / You should be honest.
You shouldn’t lie about doing your homework. / You shouldn’t be late.

sections.title: 4. 文本類型：
items: Play（戲劇）——有場景、角色、旁白和台詞；Text types: plays, notes, e-mails, rhymes
